name: @lacspace/mail-dns
description: Generate and verify a domain's email DNS records: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI. generateRecords() gives the exact records to add; checkDomain() looks them up, scores the domain 0-100 and explains every failure in plain English. Recursive SPF lookup counting (10-lookup limit, void lookups, cycles), SPF evaluation for an IP, DKIM key size, DMARC report authorization, MTA-STS policy fetch and MX coverage, provider presets (Hostinger, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho, GoDaddy, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo). Injectable resolver, DNS-over-HTTPS for edge runtimes, zero dependencies.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
